response.justification: While Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced and versatile software engineer with nearly two decades of experience, his career has been overwhelmingly focused on web, full-stack, and scripting technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, DLang, PHP). His C++ experience is minimal — roughly 6 months at National Instruments plus a university thesis project — and he shows no evidence of IEC 62443 security standards, MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols, or industrial automation domain experience, all of which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (~19 years) with strong seniority and leadership signals
Demonstrated experience with multi-threading, async I/O, and high-performance systems (in DLang, not C++)
Strong track record of mentoring, teaching, and technical communication (workshops, talks, open source)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) and not listed among current core skills
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No exposure to MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.), or industrial automation domain

key_factors.factor: No MQTT/industrial protocol or automation domain experience
